lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Two crates buys tea for the table. Tea tends to make people remember where patrols are not looking.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: North docks are loud tonight. Patrols have been pulled the other way. That should buy you time.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Then the table remains tragically thirsty.

options.text: Buy the table a round - 2 supplies
options.line: Fine. Two crates. What have you heard?
I am not paying for rumours.
